agent_changes.description: Reduced visual noise. Updated ground indicator to more clearly show its impact range. The yellow wisp is now closer to the Agent being hit, so it’s easier to see where someone is hiding before the concuss comes down. Shortened water splash on the ground for visibility.
Improved visual clarity of shield health states. The health state is now more reflected in the visual water animation.

competitive_changes: Added Updated leaderboards to display Immortal+ ranked rating thresholds
bug_fixes: General
Improved the backend technology around detection abilities (i.e. Prowler, Wingman, Dizzy, etc) so they can more reliably detect opponents within their field of view.
Added audio cleanup logic to make sure unexpected audio events don't continue playing across round transitions.
Agents
Astra
Bugfix Buff Fixed an issue where bullet tracers pass through Astra's Cosmic Divide.
Bugfix Nerf This fix does reintroduce an audio bug where there is a slight audio hitch when passing through Astra wall.
Chamber
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Chamber's Trademark in-world icon would not change color when aimed at.
Clove
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where Clove's Pick-me-up cast sound was silent for enemies.
Cypher
Bugfix Buff Fixed an issue where Cypher's Trapwire was more difficult to place than intended.
Deadlock
Bugfix Buff Fixed an issue where Deadlock's Sonic Sensor was more difficult to place than intended.
Bugfix Fixed a Spectator bug with Deadlock's Annihilation deafen where audio processing was not cleaning up as expected after a spectated player was impacted by the ability.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed issue where use of Deadlock's Annihilation on Yoru's Fakeout clone would apply audio effects to the real Yoru.
Gekko
Bugfix Fixed a bug where "Spike Down" VO would play if Wingman was destroyed right after planting the Spike.
Jett
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Jett’s Tailwind audio would continue into the next round.
Sova
Bugfix Nerf Fixed audio issue where the “being watched” sonic feedback of Sova’s Owl Drone wouldn't trigger if the drone had line-of-sight to the player when the drone spawned.
Vyse
Bugfix Fixed issue where Vyse’s Steel Garden audio could trigger twice after Observers swap targets.
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Vyse's Razorvine would leave circles on the minimap for observers when Vyse died.
Waylay
Bugfix Nerf Fixed a bug where Waylay's Saturate could affect enemies after they left the range of the area of effect.
Yoru
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Yoru's Gatecrash in-world icon would not change color when aimed at.

Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where in some cases after turning invisible, Yoru (via Dimensional Drift and Reyna (via Dismiss thru Empress) would reappear in their original location when the invisibility ends.
Premier
Bugfix Fixed an issue on the Awards tab where long names were not displayed correctly in some languages.

New Player Tips have been switched off while we fix an issue where they are being displayed for a much shorter time than intended to new players. We are actively investigating having the feature switched back on as soon as possible.
player_behavior_changes: We have adjusted our behavior system to address Remake Abuse and Gameplay Participation.

Penalties will increase for those who repeatedly AFK and dodge queues. This affects those who consistently abuse and disrupt our systems so don’t worry, we won’t be unfairly penalizing players who are genuinely trying to play.
